comparison: Both strongly support model validation (C2-C8). OpenEval provides detailed technical assessment of mRNA, protein, and enzyme activity data. Peer reviewers accepted validation without question as 'convincing evidence.' OpenEval includes C1 which peer review does not explicitly address.

Both support reduced fat mass phenotype (C9-C18). OpenEval notes caveat about statistical testing for 'similar' body weights (C12). Peer review includes C19 and C30 (TG accumulation observations) which OpenEval addresses separately in R3, treating phenotypic observations as 'compelling' evidence.

Both support residual TG accumulation findings. OpenEval comprehensively evaluates C19-C38 including temporal progression and multiple analytical methods. Peer review focuses on subset (C21, C34-C43) and treats residual TG as 'interesting finding rather than limitation.' OpenEval separates residual enzyme activity mechanism (C39-C43) while peer review groups together.

OpenEval rates UNCERTAIN for mechanistic claims about MGAT1/MGAT2 (C39-C43), noting speculation requires functional validation. Peer review rates SUPPORTED, accepting residual enzyme activity and alternative pathways as part of model characterization without questioning mechanistic inference.

Perfect claim overlap (C23-C26) on BAT phenotype. Both SUPPORTED. OpenEval provides detailed analysis of glucose uptake, glycogen accumulation, and cold exposure exception. Peer reviewers note BAT findings as part of 'compelling' comprehensive metabolic analysis contributing to favorable phenotype.

Both support fasting/torpor phenotype (C44-C52). High claim overlap. OpenEval notes video evidence and comparison to BAT DGAT DKO, suggests glucose dependency inference reasonable but could be strengthened. Peer review treats hypothermia as expected validation of depleted energy stores, includes background claims C145-C146.

Both strongly support preserved endocrine function and metabolic health (C56-C67). High claim overlap. OpenEval emphasizes this distinguishes model from typical lipodystrophy with detailed hormone and metabolite analysis. Peer review explicitly notes adiponectin/leptin preservation and 'metabolically healthier profile' as central to novel paradigm, includes C73.

Both support absence of ectopic lipid accumulation (C68-C73). OpenEval provides detailed tissue measurements and notes 10% liver TG increase is within normal variation. Peer review explicitly notes 'minimal ectopic lipid deposition' as surprising and favorable, central to conclusions. Peer review includes background claim C148.

Both strongly support HFD resistance and metabolic phenotyping (C74-C92). High claim overlap. OpenEval provides comprehensive technical assessment of DEXA, calorimetry, and tolerance tests. Peer review describes findings as 'surprising' with 'increased EE and lower RQ' as part of comprehensive assessment, includes background claims C147, C149.

Partial overlap on hepatic findings (C86-C90). OpenEval rates SUPPORTED within R8's comprehensive HFD analysis, noting modest liver changes don't indicate pathology. Peer review separately addresses hepatic findings as SUPPORTED, accepting them as part of metabolic characterization despite noting 'lacks mechanistic insight.'

Both strongly support adipose beiging (C95-C106). High claim overlap. OpenEval emphasizes remarkable 600-fold Ucp1 induction, temperature independence, and metabolite profile. Peer review explicitly notes 'enhanced browning' and 'WAT browning' as key mechanisms, with metabolic improvements 'largely attributed' to beiging. Peer review includes compensatory mechanism claims C125-C126, C150-C152.

Divergent evaluations on beiging mechanism (C107-C109). OpenEval rates SUPPORTED for non-cell-autonomous observation and SNS hypothesis as reasonable. Peer review rates UNCERTAIN, explicitly noting 'mechanisms underlying this are not entirely clear' and 'lacks mechanistic insight,' indicating speculation needs strengthening. Peer review includes C127-C128.

Both support FGF21 findings (C111-C115). OpenEval concludes endocrine FGF21 mechanism effectively ruled out on HFD while paracrine role possible. Peer review accepts FGF21 data as presented without challenge, though acknowledges mechanisms remain unclear. Peer review includes discussion claims C135-C136.

Both support key synthesis about adipose tissue maintenance and endocrine function (C116-C124). OpenEval notes leptin-adipocyte number speculation remains unproven. Peer review explicitly endorses interpretation about sensing capacity and endocrine system requirement, treating as 'key novel finding.' Peer review includes broader conclusion claims C139, C160-C161.

Minimal overlap (C125-C126) on compensatory response. OpenEval rates SUPPORTED for energy expenditure activation while acknowledging mechanistic uncertainty and speculative proposed mechanisms. Peer review addresses beiging comprehensively as SUPPORTED, treating compensatory mechanisms as convincing evidence.

Partial overlap (C127-C128) on mechanistic uncertainty. OpenEval rates SUPPORTED for acknowledging unclear mechanisms and proposing reasonable hypotheses. Peer review rates UNCERTAIN for mechanistic interpretation, explicitly noting study 'lacks mechanistic insight' and further work would 'strengthen the study.'

Minimal overlap (C135-C136) on FGF21 discussion. OpenEval rates SUPPORTED for appropriately weighing evidence and concluding endocrine effects unlikely on HFD. Peer review accepts FGF21 data without challenge as part of overall SUPPORTED evaluation despite noting mechanistic clarity lacking.

High overlap (C137-C141) on overarching conclusions. Both SUPPORTED. OpenEval justifies novel model characterization and notes appropriate acknowledgment of mechanistic uncertainty with reasonable therapeutic speculation. Peer review describes as 'valuable paradigm' and 'interesting new paradigm' providing 'exciting opportunities,' supporting conceptual framework despite unclear mechanism. Peer review includes C153.

Minimal overlap (C160-C161) on summary findings. OpenEval rates SUPPORTED for background context and accurate summary of experimental findings. Peer review focuses on interpretation of sensing mechanisms and endocrine requirements as key novel findings.

OpenEval evaluates extensive background claims (C142-C159) as SUPPORTED, providing context for experimental findings. No corresponding peer review evaluation found for these background/introductory claims.
OpenEval evaluates expected DGAT enzyme role from literature (C27-C29) as SUPPORTED with appropriate citations. No corresponding peer review evaluation found for these background claims.
